notes.detail: Shutters on every window, three hanging lanterns and a chain under the front gable, a projecting hanging sign, red carpet runners, lanterns upstairs.
notes.purpose: The projecting sign and the stable lean-to with hay and a water trough make it read as an inn.
notes.materials: Same busy mix as L1 (three woods plus white terracotta and bricks); nothing new clashes.
notes.shape: The stable lean-to on the east side and the sign arm break the box.
notes.life: Lanterns, hay and fencing; still no plants.

visual.summary: L2 adds a stable lean-to on the east side (hay, cauldron trough, fence posts), a projecting hanging sign, shutters, front-gable lanterns and red carpets inside.
problems: The 3-fence rail at (11,0,2)-(11,0,4) stands loose in the grass and reads like a stray piece: join it to the stable post at (10,0,5) (e.g. a fence at (11,0,5)) or end it on a post so it clearly reads as a hitching rail.
Reachability: common room, upper floor and the stable floor are reached; unreached places are the roof slopes, the stable roof (x10 y4 z5-9) and the hay top, which is fine.
